defmodule AuthGuard.RateLimiter do
  @moduledoc """
  Rate limiting module with exponential backoff for authentication attempts.
  Uses a sliding window counter with configurable thresholds.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @max_attempts 5
  @window_ms 300_000
  @base_delay_ms 1_000
  @max_backoff_exponent 10

  defstruct [:attempts, :window_start, :lockout_until, :total_lifetime_attempts]

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(_opts) do
    {:ok, %{clients: %{}}}
  end

  def check_rate_limit(client_id) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:check, client_id})
  end

  def record_attempt(client_id, success?) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:record, client_id, success?})
  end

  def handle_call({:check, client_id}, _from, state) do
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    client_state = Map.get(state.clients, client_id, new_client_state(now))
    client_state = maybe_reset_window(client_state, now)

    cond do
      is_locked_out?(client_state, now) ->
        remaining = client_state.lockout_until - now
        {:reply, {:error, :rate_limited, remaining}, state}

      client_state.attempts >= @max_attempts ->
        backoff = calculate_backoff(client_state)
        updated = %{client_state | lockout_until: now + backoff}
        new_state = put_in(state.clients[client_id], updated)
        {:reply, {:error, :rate_limited, backoff}, new_state}

      true ->
        {:reply, :ok, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:record, client_id, success?}, _from, state) do
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    client_state = Map.get(state.clients, client_id, new_client_state(now))
    client_state = maybe_reset_window(client_state, now)

    updated = if success? do
      %{client_state | attempts: 0, lockout_until: nil}
    else
      new_attempts = client_state.attempts + 1
      new_total = increment_total(client_state.total_lifetime_attempts)
      %{client_state | attempts: new_attempts, total_lifetime_attempts: new_total}
    end

    new_state = put_in(state.clients[client_id], updated)
    {:reply, :ok, new_state}
  end

  defp new_client_state(now) do
    %__MODULE__{
      attempts: 0,
      window_start: now,
      lockout_until: nil,
      total_lifetime_attempts: 0
    }
  end

  defp maybe_reset_window(client_state, now) do
    if now - client_state.window_start > @window_ms do
      %{client_state | attempts: 0, window_start: now}
    else
      client_state
    end
  end

  defp is_locked_out?(client_state, now) do
    client_state.lockout_until != nil and client_state.lockout_until > now
  end

  defp calculate_backoff(client_state) do
    # Exponential backoff based on total lifetime failed attempts
    # The exponent grows with repeated abuse across windows
    exponent = min(client_state.total_lifetime_attempts, @max_backoff_exponent)
    # Use bitwise shift for power-of-2 calculation
    multiplier = 1 <<< exponent
    @base_delay_ms * multiplier
  end

  defp increment_total(current) do
    # Track total attempts - Elixir integers are arbitrary precision
    # so we simply increment without any wrapping
    current + 1
  end
end

defmodule AuthGuard.Authenticator do
  @moduledoc """
  Authentication module with integrated rate limiting.
  Supports password verification with Argon2.
  """

  require Logger

  @max_retries 3
  @retry_delay_ms 100

  def authenticate(client_id, username, password) do
    case AuthGuard.RateLimiter.check_rate_limit(client_id) do
      :ok ->
        result = verify_credentials(username, password)
        AuthGuard.RateLimiter.record_attempt(client_id, result == :ok)
        result

      {:error, :rate_limited, remaining_ms} ->
        Logger.warning("Client #{client_id} rate limited for #{remaining_ms}ms")
        {:error, :rate_limited}
    end
  end

  def authenticate_with_retry(client_id, username, password) do
    do_authenticate(client_id, username, password, 0)
  end

  defp do_authenticate(client_id, username, password, attempt) when attempt < @max_retries do
    case authenticate(client_id, username, password) do
      {:error, :rate_limited} ->
        Process.sleep(@retry_delay_ms * (attempt + 1))
        do_authenticate(client_id, username, password, attempt + 1)

      {:error, :service_unavailable} ->
        Process.sleep(@retry_delay_ms)
        do_authenticate(client_id, username, password, attempt + 1)

      result ->
        result
    end
  end

  defp do_authenticate(_client_id, _username, _password, _attempt) do
    {:error, :max_retries_exceeded}
  end

  defp verify_credentials(username, password) do
    case lookup_user(username) do
      {:ok, user} ->
        if Argon2.verify_pass(password, user.password_hash) do
          :ok
        else
          {:error, :invalid_credentials}
        end

      {:error, :not_found} ->
        # Constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks
        Argon2.no_user_verify()
        {:error, :invalid_credentials}

      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("User lookup failed: #{inspect(reason)}")
        {:error, :service_unavailable}
    end
  end

  defp lookup_user(username) do
    # Simulated database lookup
    AuthGuard.UserStore.get_by_username(username)
  end
end
